docs.title: Tasklynx
docs.text: Tasklynx is a local-first developer task manager built in Rust. It combines a Git-style workflow, keyboard-friendly terminal UI, and responsive terminal-inspired web dashboard.

docs.title: Design goals
docs.text:
• Local-first and fast.
  • Keyboard-first developer workflow.
  • JSON storage that remains inspectable.
  • Cross-platform binaries.
  • Terminal aesthetics without sacrificing mobile usability.

docs.title: CLI reference
docs.text: Command Purpose add Create a task list Filter tasks complete Complete a task doing Move to doing reopen Reopen a task edit Modify a task duplicate Clone a task search Search tasks today Show due/overdue work stats Show project statistics branch Manage task branches export Export JSON/Markdown web Start dashboard

docs.title: Configuration
docs.text:
Configuration lives at ~/.config/tasklynx/config.toml on Linux/macOS. The web UI uses the same terminal-inspired palette.

accent = "#ff453a"
background = "#070809"
panel = "#101216"
foreground = "#f5f5f5"
muted = "#8f949e"
font_family = "ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, Consolas, monospace"

docs.title: Development
docs.text:
cargo fmt
cargo check --all-targets
cargo test --all-targets
cargo clippy --all-targets -- -D warnings

Release builds are triggered by pushing a semantic version tag such as v1.0.0.

docs.title: Getting started
docs.text:
tx init
tx add "Fix login bug" --project web --tag bug,auth --priority high
tx list
tx board
tx web

Set TASKLYNX_HOME to override the data location.
